title: Duolingo Correct
blurb: Bright, quick, and responsible for keeping several hundred million people doing grammar exercises they have no external reason to do. Duolingo's correct-answer chime is one of the most efficient dopamine loops ever shipped in a consumer app: it costs nothing, arrives instantly, and makes a trivial success feel measurable. The pitch rises, which your brain reads as progress whether or not any occurred. Play it whenever you get anything right at all, a spelling or a guess or a parking space, and feel your streak spiritually extend by one more day.
